description.value: Eggspectation is a breakfast-and-brunch café chain with a Richmond, BC location offering an all-day menu spanning Eggs Benedict variations, Belgian waffles, French crepes, pancakes, pasta, and burgers. Part of a chain with close to thirty locations worldwide, this outpost has been serving its signature 'breakfasty' cuisine for over 25 years. Touring cyclists will find it a solid refueling stop with a broad menu and full table service.
